attribution.findings: Outlines are model suggestions from SAM 3 that nobody has verified. A stretch without findings only means no barrier was seen in photos.
attribution.marks: SAM 3 marks above their threshold that lie near the walk or on a published view, simplified from the model's outline; nobody has checked them. Pavement, road, cobblestones and crossings describe the ground, not barriers. One thing seen in several photos is one mark per photo.
